//: The tests run against an app server that is already running, and reach its DB directly,
with the mariadb client programs, to snapshot and restore it around the tests.
The DB is the one the app's .env points at (memoEnvFile). It is restored to its state at the
start after every test that changes it: whatever anyone else does in it during the run is
lost. Never a DB in real use — the tests refuse a server or an .env of the production
environment, and a DB other than the one named here.
To have the servers started for you, on a DB of their own, use config.docker.template.json.
// expectedDB: The DB that the .env has to point at, by its DB_HOST, DB_PORT and DB_DATABASE. The tests
refuse to start on any other: an .env changed since, or a wrong one, would have them restore
over a DB not meant for them.
